gameRules.label: Allow Nether
gameRules.description: Controls whether players are allowed to enter the Nether.

gameRules.label: In block interaction explosions, some blocks won't drop their loot
gameRules.description: Some of the drops from blocks destroyed by explosions caused by block interactions are lost in the explosion.

gameRules.label: Thrown Ender Pearls vanish on death
gameRules.description: Whether Ender Pearls thrown by a player vanish when that player dies.

gameRules.label: Forgive dead players
gameRules.description: Angered neutral mobs stop being angry when the targeted player dies nearby.

gameRules.label: Global sound events
gameRules.description: When certain game events happen, like a boss spawning, the sound is heard everywhere.

gameRules.label: Lava converts to source
gameRules.description: When flowing lava is surrounded on two sides by lava sources, it converts into a source.

gameRules.label: Enable player Locator Bar
gameRules.description: When enabled, a bar is shown on the screen to indicate the direction of players.

gameRules.label: In mob explosions, some blocks won't drop their loot
gameRules.description: Some of the drops from blocks destroyed by explosions caused by mobs are lost in the explosion.

gameRules.label: Player's Nether Portal delay in creative mode
gameRules.description: Time (in ticks) that a creative mode player needs to stand in a Nether Portal before changing dimensions.

gameRules.label: Player's Nether Portal delay in non-creative mode
gameRules.description: Time (in ticks) that a non-creative mode player needs to stand in a Nether Portal before changing dimensions.

gameRules.label: Sleep percentage
gameRules.description: The percentage of players who must be sleeping to skip the night.

gameRules.label: Projectiles can break blocks
gameRules.description: Controls whether impact projectiles will destroy blocks that are destructible by them.

gameRules.label: Enable pvp
gameRules.description: Controls whether players are allowed to damage other players.

gameRules.label: Allow TNT to be activated and to explode
In TNT explosions, some blocks won't drop their loot
gameRules.description: Some of the drops from blocks destroyed by explosions caused by TNT are lost in the explosion.

gameRules.label: Universal anger
gameRules.description: Angered neutral mobs attack any nearby player, not just the player that angered them. Works best if forgiveDeadPlayers is disabled.

gameRules.label: Water converts to source
gameRules.description: When flowing water is surrounded on two sides by water sources, it converts into a source.
